method.rust: RUSTFLAGS=-C instrument-coverage; cargo +nightly test -p ffmpeg --lib --tests -- frame --skip compile_fail (with CRUSTIFY_FFMPEG_VARIANT=coverage), empty profraw dir; nightly llvm-profdata merge + llvm-cov report/show over the lib, equiv, ub_safe and ub_unsafe binaries, for libavutil/frame.rs whole and for its wave-4 region (lines 4831-5977 of the fixed tree: ENOSYS through remove_side_data, every workset wrapper and its private models)
method.c: the same run, GCOV_PREFIX into a private dir; gcov 13 -b -c -f over libavutil/frame.c (gcc 14 build)
method.note: measured on the fixed tree. Rust: frame.rs 99.61% of lines (3878 of 3893), every function run; the wave-4 region 549 of 553 lines. Its 4 misses: video_copy_is_sound's skip of a NULL plane past the format's own planes and crop_is_sound's failed recount after rounding (both unreachable: C checks those planes first, and the recount sees the planes the first count accepted), and zero_copied_buffers' failure arm, which, like try_clone's, needs the second of two equal allocations to fail after the first succeeded; no av_max_alloc limit separates them. The review's new lines (sample_rounding_overflows, default_sample_linesize and its error, copy_refusal, the preset line size in copy_into_zeroed_buffers, the refusals in try_clone, try_clone_from and assign) all run. C: frame.c 96.46% of 480 lines. Misses: the hardware paths (av_hwframe_get_buffer, av_hwframe_transfer_data, hw_frames_ctx references; no hardware context is wrapped yet), av_frame_make_writable's own failure returns (the wrapper composes C's steps; the C routine runs only as the equivalence reference), and allocation failures inside av_frame_ref/av_frame_replace/get_*_buffer that no av_max_alloc limit isolates.
